tooth_probe: Actual tooth cross-section intersected with its design bounds at each slice midpoint; not a bounding-box-only test.
deposited_bead_assumptions: Uses G-code LINE_WIDTH and path centerlines; 2D rounded bead footprint, not actual melt-flow or strength simulation. Arc chord <=0.015 mm; predecessor allowance 0.025 mm.

teeth.qualification: Raw failures are wholly embedded sub-0.02 mm2 tip slices, not the free-gap neck. Other layers give positive lower bounds for printed contact into both fin and part.

qualification_scope: Only wholly embedded tooth-tip sections <0.02 mm2 are exempted, and only when actual printed overlap in other layers proves both endpoint contacts by positive area lower bounds. Free-gap missing layers are never exempted. Layer height 0.2 mm.
